batch.description: The batch number this report covers, as a string.

at.description: ISO 8601 instant the reading finished. Optional; the engine stamps one if absent.

opened.description: Every item id you actually opened and read. This is the denominator that makes a clean verdict interpretable; an item you did not open is not a clean item.

not_opened.description: Item ids in your scope you did not reach, if any. Say so rather than leaving it to be inferred.

flagged.description: Concrete defects only. May be empty, and often should be — every flag costs an Alpha an adjudication, so a manufactured finding is worse than none.

id.description: The item id. Must be in your untouched scope.

location.description: Exact location: Statement, Definition, a numbered proof step such as 2.1, a Facts entry such as [F3], the Remark, or the title.

evidence.description: Quote the dependency's text from disk, or give the counterexample, and say why it does not license what is written. A finding with no evidence costs an Alpha a round to discover it was not one.

severity.description: Fatal is a concrete false claim, an unlicensed inference, a missing hypothesis, an inaccurate citation, or a title or Statement asserting more than the proof gives. A gap a competent reader closes in 30 seconds is nonfatal.

coverage_note.description: Plain prose: what you read fully, what you sampled, and anything you could not check.
